name: button
title: Button
description: The minimal-surface counterpart to [dialog.tsx](./dialog.tsx). Where Dialog exercises compound composition + portal + focus, Button exercises the variant + render-prop polymorphism + native-event passthrough surface.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/button

Installed to `components/ui/button.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/button';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/button

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
